source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Turn on the switch (SW1  Jumper 1) and turn it back to off. Power on the system and check BIOS setting.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: BIOS setting should be loaded to default setting.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- By switch or jumper: physically turn on the clear-CMOS jumper/SW1 and verify BIOS loads factory defaults. A physical jumper/switch actuation the agent cannot do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator flips the switch/jumper, reboots and confirms BIOS loads default settings; agent cannot physically actuate jumpers.

original_test_intent: Verify that the documented SW1/Jumper 1 clear operation loads the approved BIOS defaults and that the control is returned to its normal position.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the control from platform service documentation, records configuration and position, performs the exact powered-off clear/return sequence, powers on and compares the BIOS state with approved defaults.
manual_activity: Physical switch/jumper actuation, power handling and BIOS observation are the acceptance core; agent support is limited to evidence organization and post-handoff health collection.
required_inputs: Board schematic/service manual and exact control location
safety_requirements: Do not guess the identity, position, shorting method or power state of SW1/Jumper 1.
Operator follows ESD and vendor power isolation; control must be returned to normal before boot.
Preserve settings required for boot/storage/security recovery.
Stop on ambiguity, unexpected state change or BMC/boot loss; no automatic repeat.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only identity/health before and after, index operator photos and compare supplied BIOS captures with the approved default matrix.
Do not actuate hardware, navigate BIOS or issue the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Perform and document the exact switch/jumper sequence, verify normal final position and inspect BIOS defaults.
Restore allowed operational settings and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The narrative accurately states the physical boundary but does not supply the board-specific safe sequence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact vendor service procedure and direct BIOS evidence; OS/BMC commands are supporting health checks only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SW1/Jumper 1 actuation and 15/15-minute values remain; no alternative clear method is substituted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind photos of exact control positions and power state to a full before/after BIOS configuration diff and final normal-position verification.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact board revision documented for SW1/Jumper 1.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS/BMC and service-manual revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform schematic and clear-CMOS service procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous hardware identity, safety timing and configuration recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents wrong-control actuation and catches non-default or security/boot side effects.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board-specific control documentation and default matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A label alone is insufficient; software data cannot prove physical position.

project_override_considerations: Projects may provide board-revision-specific positions/timing, but cannot replace the named physical control with another reset path without a separate approved testcase override.
expected_evidence: Board/service-manual identity and complete BIOS baseline
BIOS default matrix comparison and health logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source names a physical control and expected default result; platform-specific location/timing are required inputs rather than conflicting semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Once documented for the target board, the operator procedure is executable; physical/manual core makes it MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its manual boundary while adding board-specific safety and recovery.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains exact identity, position, baseline and return-to-normal controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates supporting automation and engineer verdict from manual execution.

review_improvement: Prevents an assumed SW1/Jumper mapping from clearing the wrong function and makes the post-test physical state auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Board switches and jumpers are revision-specific physical controls; correct BIOS defaults can only be attributed to the intended clear operation when control identity, power state and final position are documented.
